name: Dire Maul: Warpwood Quarter (East)
location: Feralas: east wall of the Dire Maul courtyard, Eldreth Row, or the Lariss Pavilion door NE of Camp Mojache (Crescent Key)
strategy: Pusillin: chase him; kill his four imps, interrupt Fireball and Blast Wave; he drops the Crescent Key
Lethtendris: kill the imp Plimgib first; interrupt her shadow casts
Hydrospawn: agree whether to kill the Hydrolings or the boss first
Zevrin Thornhoof: heal players sent to the altar (Divine Shield / Ice Block can escape it)
Alzzin the Wildshaper: clear the Warpwood Crushers on the ramp; regain threat after form changes; AoE adds at 35%
Isalien (summoned): kill her hippogryph first; interrupt heals
tips: Mine the Rich Thorium Veins behind Alzzin

name: Dire Maul: Capital Gardens (West)
location: West wall of the Dire Maul courtyard (Crescent Key)
strategy: Tendris Warpwood: kill the wandering Ancients first; avoid Trample and Entangle
Magister Kalendris: interrupt Mind Blast and Mind Flay; retaunt after Dominate Mind
Tsu'zee (rare): keep her in front; dispel Blind
Illyanna Ravenoak: fight in melee; crowd-control Ferra; kill Illyanna first
Immol'thar: destroy the Eyes; save cooldowns for the 50% enrage (deactivate all five crystals first)
Prince Tortheldrin: tank in a corner; rebuild threat after Arcane Blast
Lord Hel'nurath: Warlock epic-mount event: keep the Warlock alive
tips: Kill the Arcane Aberrations and Mana Remnants at the five crystals before Immol'thar

name: Dire Maul: Gordok Commons (North)
location: North wall of the Dire Maul courtyard (Crescent Key), or from West through the Athenaeum
strategy: Guard Mol'dar: tank at a wall; cooldowns for Enrage
Stomper Kreeg: or skip him once he falls asleep drunk
Guard Fengus: tank at a wall, or lure him away and take the key
Guard Slip'kik: or trap him by repairing the Broken Trap (Frost Oil + Thorium Widget)
Captain Kromcrush: crowd-control his Reavers; stay behind him (Mortal Cleave)
King Gordok: interrupt Cho'Rush; on a tribute run keep Cho'Rush alive
tips: Tribute run: leave the guards alive, kill only King Gordok, and loot the Gordok Tribute chest plus two-hour buffs
Bring Frost Oil, a Thorium Widget, leather, runecloth and rune thread, plus 300 lockpicking, a Seaforium Charge or a Truesilver Skeleton Key
